title: Kitab al-Aghani
summary: The Kitab al-Aghani (Book of Songs) is a multivolume 10th-century Arabic work by Abu al-Faraj al-Isbahani. It collects poems and songs with biographical notes and information on the lives and customs of early Arabs and of Umayyad and Abbasid Muslims, and is a major source on early Islamic music and musical life.

uncertainty.note: Sources give the century and the author's death year (967 per Britannica; Iranica says 966 widely accepted but possibly after 972), not a completion date for the book.

where.modern_name: Baghdad, Iraq (proxy pin: the author's city of upbringing and death, not a stated place of composition)

importance.justification: Described by Britannica as the most important source on music and musical life in Islam's first three centuries.

sources.title: Abu'l-Faraj Esfahani, Ali b. al-Hosayn
sources.publisher: Encyclopaedia Iranica (Columbia University, Center for Iranian Studies)
